description: Set the value of a custom field on a task. Requires taskId or taskName + fieldId or fieldName + value.

team_id.description: The ClickUp Team ID or Workspace Name to use. If provided, the server will switch to this workspace for this and subsequent requests in the current session.

value.description: Value to set. Supports type coercion: labels/names for drop_down or labels fields, natural language (e.g., 'next Friday', 'tomorrow') or Unix ms for date, booleans for checkbox.

valueOptions.description: Optional configuration for setting field values.

name: set_custom_field_value
